name: Masimo Semiconductor
old_description: Masimo Semiconductor has been developing and manufacturing III-V opto-electronic devices since 1982. Masimo Semiconductor’s scientists and engineers cumulatively have over 100 years of experience and account for over 140 publications, 34 patents, and 3 world record discrete semiconductor devices.
about:
Masimo Semiconductor was founded in 1982 in Hudson, New Hampshire, and has since focused on the development and manufacture of III‑V opto‑electronic devices. The privately held company operates from a facility at 25 Sagamore Park Road in Hudson.

The company specializes in wafer epitaxy, foundry services, and device fabrication. Its core processes include GaAs and InP MOCVD epitaxy, custom III‑V epitaxial growth, device fabrication, optical coating evaporation, and device testing. Masimo Semiconductor offers prototype through high‑volume production runs, supported by an on‑site Agnitron A300 MOCVD reactor installed in 2023 and advanced metrology equipment for epitaxial film and device characterization.

Masimo Semiconductor serves the healthcare, industrial, energy, datacom/telecom, security, and consumer products markets. Its components are used in high‑brightness LEDs for medical and commercial applications, as well as in optoelectronics, biomedical devices, and telecommunications systems.

The company positions itself as a cost‑effective product development and manufacturing partner that does not compete with its customers. It emphasizes close collaboration, protection of customer intellectual property, fast turnaround from prototype to volume, and a staff of epitaxy professionals with over 35 years of industry experience. Quality management conforms to ISO 9001:2015.
